# Cyber Access Protocol

> A 2D cyber-security action platformer about a junior operator restoring a locked-down technology tower, then rebuilding the living operations campus behind it.

Cyber Access Protocol is a single-player, offline game set in Asterion Tower and the
AEGIS Operations Campus. It spans 70 levels and 60 missions across seven chapters, from
the tower lobby to the living system. The final chapter adds ten operational domains,
a configuration workbench, a persistent character sheet, sixteen dialogue conversations,
practical certification and three Level 70 operating models.

## Main pages

- [Overview](index.html): What Cyber Access Protocol is, the incident, design pillars, V7 systems and key facts.
- [Campaign](campaign.html): All 70 levels across seven chapters, with an image for every level.
- [Gameplay](gameplay.html): The core loop, abilities, V7 workbench, character sheet, dialogue, mission structure, threats, bosses, controls and accessibility.
- [Gallery](gallery.html): 95 screens from the game, filterable by campaign, chapter, bosses, interface, dialogue and endings.
- [Field Manual](field-manual.html): 28 disciplines across three campaigns, the V7 workbench, consequences, six endings and the full boss roster.
- [The Journey](changelog.html): How the campaign grew chapter by chapter.
- [Press Kit](press.html): Fact sheet, approved copy, cast, screenshots, logo and current status.

## Key facts

- 70 levels, 60 missions, seven chapters.
- 28 specialist disciplines; 20 new bosses in Chapters VI–VII.
- Six endings across two finals: Level 50 and Level 70.
- Single-player and offline; no account, leaderboard or online requirement.
- Windows PC; more platforms to be announced.
- English and Urdu, with full right-to-left support.
- Fictional setting. The game never touches real systems, credentials or networks.
